name: Strip Carousel
description: The strip tilts like a spinning drum while it scrolls. The side you are scrolling toward leans away with a gentle perspective and shade, and the strip flattens back out as it settles.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Tilt
parameters.description: How far the strip leans at a given scroll speed.

parameters.name: Depth Shading
parameters.description: How much the receding side darkens.
